'''Tyus Huols''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, he worked as an equipment [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where he ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]]. Huols had no hair, [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin. While at his stall, he wore white and brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] and carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyus Huols first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game, he serves as a Republic speciality goods vendor on Corellia. His location was also marked on a map in the accompanying [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide|strategy guide]], which gave his first name.
